title: Mean of full parity
statement: Let $\\iota$ be a finite, nonempty set, and choose independent uniform signs $x_i\\in\\{-1,1\\}$ for each $i\\in\\iota$. The expected value of their product is zero: $\\mathbb E\\prod_{i\\in\\iota}x_i=0$.
